description: Canonical registry of Contrix-defined MLS (RFC 9420) GroupContext extensions occupying the MLS private-use ExtensionType range 0xF000-0xFFFF. Maintained so SDKs and conformance tooling have a single machine-readable entry for each Contrix MLS extension codepoint, preventing collisions between future Contrix extensions in the private-use range and recording any future migration to an IANA standard codepoint.

private_use_range.reference: RFC 9420 §17.6; IANA MLS Extension Types registry (private-use range)

extensions.name: mls_governance_binding
extensions.carries: Contrix Realm/Circle governance binding inside the MLS GroupContext
extensions.migration: If a network-wide registration is ever required, request a standard codepoint via the IETF MLS extensions registry (specification-required) and declare it in a new hardening profile as a separate wire version; do not override this binding with another codepoint inside v1.
